items.q: Do I need a separate account?
items.a: No. Use the same OWeb OneID you already have. Artemiis One is a satellite app on shared One OS auth.

items.q: Where is my API key stored?
items.a: BYOK keys are stored in your browser per user and workspace unless your team uses a hosted proxy. We do not store MuAPI secrets on the satellite server by default.
Yes. Workspace-scoped generation history and team panels help operators collaborate without sharing passwords.

items.q: Is this the same as OWeb?
items.a: Artemiis One is focused on generative media. OWeb remains your control plane — launch this app from the store or sign in directly.
